description: Mỗi phách mạnh khung phóng vụt lên một chút rồi lùi về rất nhanh, mạnh hơn sau đoạn drop.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-punch, written here): On each downbeat scale jumps by +0.03 (+0.07 after the drop) and decays back with time constant 0.11 s: s = 1 + A e^(-t / 0.11). Demo: A 0.07 every 0.5 s (120 BPM). Params: amp (0.03 / 0.07) · decay (τ 0.11 s) · beats.
